generalCriterionList.description: The original documents should be produced for verification at any stage of tender process as and when sought for, failing which, the bids are liable for disqualification.
Rates shall be quoted in tender in bill of quantities in the website itself
Conditional tenders are liable for rejection.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The tender document is part and parcel of the agreement.
The Bidder shall obtain insurance coverage for all the workers deployed for this work at his own cost.
The Bidder shall quote rates exclusive of GST and inclusive of all other applicable taxes, levies, duties and cess etc., as per the prevailing regulations of GoI and GoK.

Any variation in GST during the contract period upward/ downward shall be paid or recovered. The Contractor and KPCL have agreed for the same. All payments towards variation in GST shall be on production of documentary proof.

The bidder should take into account the prevailing royalty charges while quoting their rates and submit the Material Dispatch Permit(MDP) receipt, if not submitted penalty shall be levied as per statutory norms issued by GoK.
As per Building and other construction workers Welfare Cess Act 1995, 1% Cess on bill amount shall be recovered in the work bills.
KPCL shall recover the statutory taxes such as Income Tax, cess, etc., at the prevailing applicable rates.
The contractor should get registration under section 7 & workers under section 12 of the building and other construction workers as per regulation of employment and condition of service act 1996.

The bidder should read the restrictions imposed by the Government of India & Government of Karnataka on procurement from bidders from a country or countries or class of countries which shares a land border with India and give the declaration for the same as per enclosed format. Any bidder from a country which shares a land with India will be eligible to bid in this tender only if the bidder is registered with the Competent Authority.

Bidders shall give declaration regarding payment of fair and reasonable wages, which shall not be less than the minimum wages fixed by the government from time to time to the labours working under the contractor in the contract undertaken by him, failing which the bids are liable for rejection.

In case of the death of a contractor after executing the agreement/ commencement of the work, his legal heir, if an eligible registered contractor and willing, can execute and complete the work at the accepted tender rates irrespective of the cost of the work.

Any dispute or difference or claim arising out of, or in connection with, or relating to the present contract or the breach, termination or invalidity thereof, shall be referred and settled under Arbitration center- Karnataka (domestic and international) rules 2012, by one or more arbitrators appointed in accordance with its rules.
In case the dates notified above are declared as holiday, the immediate next working day will be reckoned.
Defect liability/ Maintenance period for the work is 12(twelve) months from the date of completion of the work.
If the Bidder makes any alterations in the conditions of the contract or puts any condition of his own, such tenders are liable for rejection.
The bidders should read, understand, sign and shall upload the declarations along with the bid. The declarations are attached towards the end of the bid document.
In the item description in Schedule-B, the material to be used for the work should confirm with relevant IS standards. The material can be procured/used only after approval from Engineer in charge.

The location where the work is to be carried out is to be completely studied by the bidder. Any electrical cables, power cables, transformers, OFC, etc., laid need to be understood. The safety of men, material, instruments is to be strictly taken care of. Any lapse/incidents/accidents/loss is the total responsibility of bidder.

Security Deposit: Contract performance Guarantee: The Successful bidder shall furnish a Contract performance guarantee (CPG) equivalent to 5% of the tendered amount or contract price whichever is higher in the form of DD/RTGS/NEFT/e-BG/BG from any schedule bank acceptable to the Corporation in the prescribed format within 20 days of receipt of acceptance letter from KPCL and should be valid for 30days after the date of defect liability period including extension period if any.
The contract may be foreclosed/extended beyond the original contract period as per the decision of KPCL.
The corporation is not responsible for any delay in accessing Karnataka Public procurement Portal(KPPP).
Corrigendum/ modification/ corrections, if any, will be published in the web site only.
Further details of the work or any clarifications can be obtained from the office of the Executive Engineer(Civil)Supa, KPCL, Ganeshgudi(U.K) during office hours.

technicalCriterionList.description: The intending bidder should have satisfactorily completed as a prime contractor in the last five financial years (i,e. 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24 , 2024-25 & 2025-26), any civil work of value not less than Rs.25.94lakhs. The work done certificate issued from state / central government/Government under taking from officers not below the rank of Executive Engineer or equivalent cadre shall be furnished. (Weightage of 10% per year will be given to the cost of completed works of previous years to bring them to the price level of present financial year).

Assessed available tender capacity (AXNX2.5-B) should be greater than the amount put to tender, where, A is Maximum value of works executed in any one year during the last Five years (updated to 2026-27) price level taking into account the completed as well as works in progress. N is Number of years prescribed for completion of the works for which tenders are invited for 03 Months (0.25 year) B is Value, at 2026-27 price level, of existing commitments and on-going works to be completed during the next 03 Months

itemList.description: Dismantling roofing including ridges, hips, valleys and gutters etc., and stacking the material to the appropriate disposal area as per direction of Engineer-in-charge.Asbestos cement sheet

Providing and fixing of 30mm thick sandwich puff panel, density of 38kg/m3 +/-2, Top sheet 0.4mm thick, bottom sheet 0.35mm thick and approved color with 10 year company guarantee and certified with ISO 9001:2008. The roofing sheets shall be fixed to the structural steel frame work to correct line and level with overlap 15 cm, side overlap 1 corrugation, maximum purlin distance 90 cm. Fixing with HP make self drilling and self tapping screws of 90mm to 100mm length, 10mm to 12mm head and minimum 3 screws per sqm sheet of matching sheet color complete as per manufactures specifications and as per the direction of the Engineer in charge the rates are inclusive of cost of all materials, fixing, drilling, transportation, loading & unloading charges at site, all other necessary accessories & all applicable taxes etc.

Providing and fixing ridges, Top ridge: 12" x 12" & bottom ridge: 8"x8" and approved color & certified with ISO:9001:2008. Fixing with 30mm thick sandwich puff panel with HP make self drilling and self tapping screws of 90mm to 100mm length, 10mm to 12mm head and minimum 3 screws per sqm sheet of matching sheet color complete as per manufactures specifications and as per the direction of the Engineer in charge the rates are inclusive of cost of all materials, fixing, drilling, transportation, loading & unloading charges at site, all other necessary accessories & all applicable taxes etc.
a) Ridge(Portion)

Providing and fixing ridges, Top ridge: 12" x 12" & bottom ridge: 8"x8" and approved color & certified with ISO:9001:2008. Fixing with 30mm thick sandwich puff panel with HP make self drilling and self tapping screws of 90mm to 100mm length, 10mm to 12mm head and minimum 3 screws per sqm sheet of matching sheet color complete as per manufactures specifications and as per the direction of the Engineer in charge the rates are inclusive of cost of all materials, fixing, drilling, transportation, loading & unloading charges at site, all other necessary accessories & all applicable taxes etc.
b)Valley(Portion)

Painting with synthetic enamel paint of approved brand and manufacture of required colour to give an even shade :One coats on old work as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer in charge.

Providing and laying in position Cement Concrete for levelling course for all works in foundation. The granite/trap/basalt crushed graded coarse aggregates and fine aggregates as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed, laid in layers not exceeding 150 mm thickness, well compacted using plate vibrators, including all lead & lifts, cost of all materials of quality, labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing, and all the other appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications. Mix 1:3:6 Using 40 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse aggregates

Providing Brick work with common burnt clay Non Modular bricks of class designation 3.5 in foundation and plinth in Cement mortar 1:4 (1 cement : 4 coarse sand) including cost of all materials, labour, scaffolding and usage charges of machinery & other incidental charges complete as per the direction of engineer incharge of work.

Providing 12 mm cement plaster with cement mortar 1:4 (1 cement: 4 fine sand) to brick masonry including rounding off corners wherever required smooth rendering, providing and removing scaffolding, including cost of materials, labour, curing complete as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer-in-charge.

Finishing walls with 100% Premium acrylic emulsion paint having VOC less than 50 g/L and UV resistance as per IS 15489:2004, Alkali & fungal resistance, dirt resistance exterior paint of required shade (Company Depot Tinted) with silicon additives, New work (Two coats applied @ 1.43 L/ 10 m². Over and including priming coat of exterior primer applied @ 0.90 L/10 m² with paint of approved quality to give an even shade, after thoroughly brooming the surface to remove all dirt, dust, mortar drops and foreign matter including preparing the surface even and sand paper smooth, cost of materials, labour complete as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer-in-charge.

Providing and fixing precoated galvanised steel sheet roofing accessories 0.50 mm (+0.05 %) total coated thickness, Zinc coating 120 g/m2 as per IS: 277, in 240 mpa steel grade, 5-7 microns epoxy primer on both side of the sheet and polyester top coat 15-18 microns using self drilling/ self tapping screws complete : Gutter (600 mm over all girth)

Distempering with 1st quality acrylic distemper, having VOC (Volatile Organic Compound) content less than 50 g/L, of approved brand and manufacture, including applying additional coats wherever required, to achieve even shade and colour. One coat as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer in charge.

Providing and fixing Structural Steel work riveted, bolted or welded in built up sections, trusses and framed work, including cutting, hoisting, fixing in position and applying a priming coat of approved steel primer all complete including cost of materials, labour, usage charges of machinery complete as per specifications and as per directions of the Engineer-in- Charge.

Painting with synthetic enamel paint of approved brand and manufacture to give an even shade :Two coats on new work after thoroughly brooming the surface to remove all dirt, dust, mortar drops and foreign matter including preparing the surface even and sand paper smooth, cost of materials, labour complete as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer-in-charge.

Providing and fixing on wall face unplasticised Rigid PVC rain water pipes inclundin all fixures conforming to IS : 13592 Type A, including jointing with seal ring conforming to IS : 5382, leaving 10 mm gap for thermal expansion, (i) Single socketed pipes 100 mm diameter

Providing and fixing tiled false ceiling of specified materials of size 595x595 mm in true horizontal level, suspended on inter locking metal grid of hot dipped galvanized steel sections ( galvanized @ 120 g/m2, both side inclusive) consisting of main ""T"" runner with suitably spaced joints to get required length and of size 24x38 mm made from 0.30 mm thick (minimum) sheet, spaced at 1200 mm center to center and cross ""T"" of size 24x25 mm made of 0.30 mm thick (minimum) sheet, 1200 mm long spaced between main ""T"" at 600 mm center to center to form a grid of 1200x600 mm and secondary cross ""T"" of length 600 mm and size 24x25 mm made of 0.30 mm thick (minimum) sheet to be interlocked at middle of the 1200x600 mm panel to form grids of 600x600 mm and wall angle of size 24x24x0.3 mm and laying false ceiling tiles of approved texture in the grid including, required cutting/making, opening for services like diffusers, grills, light fittings, fixtures, smoke detectors etc. Main ""T"" runners to be suspended from ceiling using GI slotted cleats of size 27 x 37 x 25 x1.6 mm fixed to ceiling with 12.5 mm dia and 50 mm long dash fasteners, 4 mm GIadjustable rods with galvanised butterfly level clips of size 85 x 30 x 0.8 mm spaced at 1200 mm center to center along main T, bottom exposed width of 24 mm of all T- sections shall be pre-painted with polyester paint, all complete for all heights as per specifications, drawings and as directed by Engineer-in-charge.12.5 mm thick square edge PVC Laminated Gypsum Tile of size 595x595 mm, madeof Gypsum plasterboard, manufactured from natural gypsum as per IS 2095 part I and laminated with white 0.16mm thick fire retardant PVC film on the face side and 12micron metalized polyester on the back side with all edges sealed with the face side PVC film which goes around and wraps the edges and is bonded to the edges and the back side metalized polyester film so as to make the tile a completely sealed unit.

Providing and fixing precoated galvanised iron profile sheets (size, shape and pitch of corrugation as approved by Engineer-in-charge) 0.50 mm (+ 0.05 %) total coated thickness with zinc coating 120 g/m2 as per IS: 277, in 240 mpa steel grade, 5-7 microns epoxy primer on both side of the sheet and polyester top coat 15-18 microns. Sheet should have protective guard film of 25 microns minimum to avoid scratches during transportation and should be supplied in single length upto 12 m or as desired by Engineerin-charge. The sheet shall be fixed using self drilling/self tapping screws of size (5.5x 55 mm) with EPDM seal, complete upto any pitch in horizontal/ vertical or curved surfaces, excluding the cost of purlins, rafters and trusses and including cutting to size and shape wherever required.

Providing and fixing of Aluminium composite panel of approved make and colour for wall cladding for Brick/Rcc/stone walls & coloumns/beams with necessary aluminium frame works at required level made out of 50x25x4mm C section or equivalent. The panel should consist of 3mm thick non-halogenated FR grade ineral based polymer ( 2 hrs fire resistance as per ASTM E119-12 and clause B,S1, do as per ENT 13501-1sandwiched between 0.50 skins thick aluminium sheet making a total panel thickness of 4mm. The surfaces will be finished with PVDF based coating on topsides and service coating on reverse sides would be in polyester paint. The system shall be fixed using GI brackets, aluminium L cleats and stainless steel bolts and nuts complete with spring washer and cap nuts and all other necessary accessories, sealing shall be done with necessary rods etc., complete -For Straight Portion

Providing and fixing 12 mm thick frameless toughened glass door shutter of approved brand and manufacture, including providing and fixing top & bottom pivot & double acting hydraulic floor spring type fixing arrangement and making necessary holes etc. for fixing required door fittings, all complete as per direction of Engineer-in-charge (Door handle, lock and stopper etc. to be paid separately) including cost of materials, labour, usage charges of machinery complete as per specifications and as per directions of the Engineer-in-Charge.
Providing and fixing of etched self adhesive sticker for existing toughned glass door.
Providing and fixing stainless steel 304 grade fancy handle of approved make fixed with SS screws etc. complete as per direction of Engineer-incharge. 200mm length
Providing and fixing Stainless Steel Fixtures conforming to 304 graded steel as per direction of engineer in charge SS Door stopper 75mm.

Providing and Fixing sliding arrangement in rack/cupboards/cabinets shutter by with stainless steel rollers to run inside C or E aluminium channel secton (The payment C or E channel shall be made separately)

Fixing of aluminuim composite panel doors/toughned glass doors with hinges, tower bolt, handle and cylindrical lock including cost & conveyane of materials as per the directions of engineering-in-charge.

Earth work excavation by manual means for drains, canals, waste weir, draft, approach channels, key trenches, foundation of Buildings & bridges and such simillar works in all kinds of soils, as per drawing and technical specifications, including setting out, shoring, strutting, barricading, caution lights, removal of stumps and other deleterious matter, excavated surface leveled and sides neatly dressed disposing off the excavated stuff or sorting & stacking the selected stuff for reuse in a radius of 50 m and lift upto 1.5 m including cost of labour, tools & other appurtenaces required to complete the work. In all kinds of soils Depth upto 1.5 m

Aluminium sheeting 2mm thick or Aluminium composite material ACM sheeting - 3mm Thick fixed with Micro Prismatic (HIP) Type IV sheeting including 2% towards cost of drilling holes, nuts, bolts etc.and signs as applicable (lettering included)

Providing of 3M radium reflector of kiwilite or nikwilite japan made cutting letters with identification retro reflectorised sign with outer borders including LOGOS over the existing ACP sheets, as per approved drawings and designs including cost of materials, labour and transportation complete as per directions of Engineer-in-charge.
